/** Radial stagger plus checkerboard parity gives each tile its own flip phase. */
export function flipProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows) {
  const radius = Math.hypot(column - (columns - 1) / 2, row - (rows - 1) / 2);
  const delay = radius * 45 + ((column + row) % 2) * 55;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (elapsed - delay) / 420));
}

/** Capture two temporary screens and flip their tiles outward in a checker ripple. */
export function createMapTransition(canvas) {
  let oldScreen;
  let newScreen;
  let elapsed = 0;
  const columns = 12; // EDIT checkerboard density.
  const rows = 7;
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /** Snapshot a rendered frame once, rather than allocating images every tick. */
  function snapshot() {
    const image = document.createElement('canvas');
    image.width = canvas.width;
    image.height = canvas.height;
    image.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    return image;
  }

  /** Capture the old map before the owner changes map and camera state. */
  function begin() {
    if (oldScreen) return false;
    oldScreen = snapshot();
    newScreen = null;
    elapsed = 0;
    return true;
  }

  /** Cover the new rendered map with independently flipping old/new tiles. */
  function draw(context, delta) {
    if (!oldScreen) return;
    if (!newScreen) newScreen = snapshot();
    elapsed += delta * 1000;
    if (reducedMotion || elapsed >= 900) {
      oldScreen = null;
      newScreen = null;
      return;
    }
    context.save();
    context.fillStyle = '#10283f';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    for (let row = 0; row < rows; row++) {
      for (let column = 0; column < columns; column++) {
        const p = flipProgress(elapsed, column, row, columns, rows);
        const x = Math.round(column * canvas.width / columns);
        const y = Math.round(row * canvas.height / rows);
        const width = Math.round((column + 1) * canvas.width / columns) - x;
        const height = Math.round((row + 1) * canvas.height / rows) - y;
        const scale = Math.max(0.001, Math.abs(Math.cos(p * Math.PI)));
        context.save();
        context.translate(x + width / 2, y + height / 2);
        if ((row + column) % 2) context.scale(1, scale);
        else context.scale(scale, 1);
        context.drawImage(p < 0.5 ? oldScreen : newScreen,
          x, y, width, height, -width / 2, -height / 2, width, height);
        context.restore();
      }
    }
    context.restore();
  }

  return { begin, draw, get active() { return Boolean(oldScreen); } };
}

export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();

/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
    ? elapsed / riseDuration
    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
  return smooth * 0.85;
}

/** Advance visual feedback independently of whether movement AI is paused. */
export function advanceDamageFlash(character, delta) {
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed === undefined) return;
  character.damageFlashElapsed += delta * 1000;
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed >= damageFlashDuration) {
    delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
  }
}

/** Cache a white silhouette retaining the original image's transparent pixels. */
export function getWhiteSprite(image) {
  if (!whiteSprites.has(image)) {
    const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
    surface.width = image.naturalWidth;
    surface.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = surface.getContext('2d');
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, surface.width, surface.height);
    whiteSprites.set(image, surface);
  }
  return whiteSprites.get(image);
}
